title: First code on GitHub
text: Opened the TPCT GitHub account and started publishing small Python and PHP utilities.

title: First role at Aqua Web, first freelance clients
text: Joined Aqua Web in Alexandria as a junior web developer and started freelancing. By 2019 I had built 20+ modular MVC apps there, and freelance work grew to ~250 projects in Python and PHP.

title: Full-stack engineer at WeDoAcc
text: Built a productized accounting suite (invoicing, billing, reporting) and a CRM in Laravel. A service-repository pattern sped up feature delivery by 30%.

title: C, compilers and embedded systems
text: Wrote a compiler in C for an assembly-style language targeting a home-made 16-bit computer. Alongside it: AVR drivers, an EEPROM programmer and reusable C libraries.

title: Full-stack engineer at Stackdeans
text: Shipped 10+ Laravel sites with Stripe and AI features, lifting conversions by 25%, on reusable MVC components and Docker-based CI/CD.

title: CTO at Venu Dine
text: Moved from senior back-end developer to CTO of a food-tech startup. I owned the FastAPI and Laravel backend and the Flutter apps, and its multi-vendor restaurant APIs served 200k+ daily requests with 100% uptime.

title: Team leader at dot.jo
text: Led a Yii2 team in Jordan across 25+ projects, including 3 bank websites and high-profile Jordanian clients. A headless CMS built on Filament cut project delivery from about a month to 4 days.

title: Senior software engineer at Kearney
text: Joined Kearney on contract for government work: refactoring a platform for stability and scalability and hardening its environment.

title: CTO at IPXBit
text: Moved a multi-tenant platform from microservices to a modular monolith with a database per module, cutting server costs from $15k to $2k. I led the UI/UX, frontend, backend and mobile teams.

title: Bilingual Banking CMS open-sourced
text: Published the Arabic/English Laravel and Filament CMS behind a bank's public website, with RBAC, audit logging and Excel import/export.

title: National Waste Analytics Platform
text: Led full-stack development of a national waste analytics platform in Saudi Arabia on Django and React, with real-time maps and SSO. Oracle multi-view optimisation over 100M+ rows cut data fetches from 3 s to 500 ms.

title: Team lead at Raqmix, senior engineer at Everything To Gain
text: Led Python development teams at Raqmix. At the same time I built multi-tenant Laravel, FastAPI and .NET apps for a US company, with PayPal, MasterCard and HyperPay integrations.

title: CEO of ShiftCodes
text: Now leading ShiftCodes, my software studio, full-time. Its systems include the AIC Operations Suite, a multi-school learning platform, and ERP and multi-tenant CRM work.

title: Technical lead for Monglish and Edulixa360
text: Senior technical team lead and consultant for Monglish International Academy in Egypt and Edulixa360 in Saudi Arabia, managing the technical staff and leading hands-on.

title: JenDock
text: Released self-hosted, Jenkinsfile-compatible CI/CD for Docker Compose apps. It deploys and rolls back automatically when health checks fail.
